summary: Do not report intentional mission waits as unexplained stalls

schema.detail: No database, claim, index or wire change.

compatibility.detail: Named and default stall reporting share intentional-wait classification with waiting-on. A run is suppressed only when every unfinished step positively waits on a known false predicate, an unanswered human gate, a native person ask, a blocker, a retry backoff or a live holder's declared wait. Each read/evaluation resolves and parses the pinned definition once per generation, shared across its steps, with at most four fresh warm observation peeks per predicate step. Human request reads seek the existing owner-leading human episode index and keep canonical deterministic ordering. Unknown evidence, pending unclassified work and child-linked holds preserve prior reporting. Terminal notices, message identity, idempotency, ask delivery cadence and client-v0 are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores earlier stall behavior without changing stored state.
